sourceObservations: Question paper page 22 gives 250 g and supplies the weight formula. The wooden-strip apparatus provides context but no diagram measurement is needed for part (a).
Mark scheme page 13 awards substitution/evaluation, ignores units and applies one deduction for a clear mass-unit power-of-ten error. It accepts g=10, 9.8 or 9.81 for the original question.
General guidance page 3 supports positive application of the scheme and consultation when uncertain. It does not supply a universal rounding or conflicting-working policy for this task.

decisions: Both representations preserve conversion and multiplication. Neither requires inference of an extra force or an inverse calculation.
Explicit g removes a lookup/choice and makes applying an alternative g a new assessment decision; do not import the source acceptance list blindly.
